item.title: 'New era': Browns fans sound off on Monken hire
item.description: With new leadership now confirmed, Browns fans are wasting no time sounding off about the Haslam's newest hire.

item.title: Texas man convicted of 2 fatal shootings becomes the 1st executed in US this year
item.description: A Texas man who once escaped custody and spent three days on the run after being sentenced to death for fatally shooting his ex-girlfriend and her new boyfriend was put to death Wednesday, becoming the first person executed in the United States this year.

item.title: Chia seeds sold by Amazon, Whole Foods recalled over salmonella risk
item.description: A "superfood" sold nationwide is under recall over the risk of salmonella contamination.

item.title: I-Team: What the governor just said about state money for Browns dome
item.description: Gov. Mike DeWine spoke out to the FOX 8 I-Team about what happens if a court blocks state money for a new Cleveland Browns dome.

item.title: US Marshals arrest second suspect in deadly shooting at downtown Cleveland nightclub
item.description: U.S. Marshals on Wednesday arrested the second suspect in a deadly shooting that happened at a nightclub in downtown Cleveland last month.

item.title: Cavaliers take 129-99 win as LeBron James comes to Cleveland with Lakers
item.description: Donovan Mitchell scored 25 points, Jaylon Tyson had 20 and the Cleveland Cavaliers used a big third quarter to beat the Los Angeles Lakers 129-99 and spoil LeBron James' return to Northeast Ohio.

item.title: I-Team: New justice for abused pets in Cuyahoga County
item.description: Cuyahoga County prosecutors have created a new unit to handle cases of animal abuse.

item.title: CLOSINGS: Akron Schools, several others cancel Thursday classes
item.description: For the fourth time this week, several local schools will be closed on Thursday as dangerously cold conditions continue across Northeast Ohio.

item.title: Canopy collapses onto cars at Canton apartment complex: 'I can't leave my house'
item.description: As the massive winter storm was dumping more than a foot of snow on Stark County on Sunday, residents in the Oak Glen Apartments in Canton heard a loud "boom" and then a car alarm.

item.title: Cold Weather Advisory: Wind chills as low as 20 below zero for some counties
item.description: Another Cold Weather Advisory has been issued for Northeast Ohio.
